title: Meguri performance result
description: One run of one performance suite (U12, R1863, R1864): UI performance tests (tools/scripts/perf-compare from an xcresult), criterion wall-clock benches (meguri-testkit bench::report) and gungraun instruction counts (perf-compare from gungraun's JSON). U241's perf-gate reads it. Bump schema_version on any incompatible change.

suite.description: What ran: a UI test class (SmokePerfTests), a bench target (open) or a gungraun bench file (icount_open).

kind.description: ui: XCTest metrics from a simulator, device or Mac run; wall-clock: criterion with per-operation samples; instruction-count: gungraun under valgrind.

configuration.description: The build: the Xcode configuration for ui (only Profile counts, R1866), the cargo profile for core benches (bench).

runner.description: Where it ran. Baselines are keyed by id (U241).

id.description: The baseline key: model and OS build for simulators and devices, CPU and OS for hosts.

memory_measure.description: What memory rows measure: the process's phys_footprint on Apple hosts and devices, its resident set in Docker.

attachments.description: UI results: the attachments, screenshots included, that the suite's tests kept (R1866 wants none). Absent when a measured test had no activities to count them from; U241's gate refuses a UI result without it.

name.description: The interval (IntervalNames, R1861) or benchmark the value belongs to; for XCTest's own metrics, xctest.<metric>.

test.description: The test that measured it (ui): Class/testMethod().

metric.description: duration, instructions, memory, hitch-ratio, hitch-time, launch, cpu-time, clock, or another XCTest metric in kebab case.

percentile.description: Absent for a single exact value (an instruction count). pN is the smallest sample with fewer than (100 - N)% of the samples above it, so a percentile never hides the slow tail.

samples.description: How many measurements the value comes from: operations for core benches, iterations for UI tests.

fixture.description: The collection measured on (10k, 150k, ..., or a named fixture), when there is one: core benches name it, UI tests declare it (PerfTestCase.fixture).

measurements.description: Every measurement in unit, for UI metrics (one per iteration).

breakdown.description: Parts reported beside a memory row, in its unit; never gated (R1864: SQLite allocates outside Rust's allocator).
